purpose: Canonical full-replay test of a gradient-magnitude-validated CPU camera-motion score for the camera-guarded stationary sequence architecture.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged. Mode 22 was behaviorally identical to mode 21 except benchmark P6.y used the structural camera score; modes 0-21 retained the original raw-luminance score.
interpretation: Mode 22 is rejected. The structural camera score left all weak/stationary metrics exactly equal to mode 21, proving that substituting P6.y was not the cause of low-frequency state loss. It also regressed fast-pan MAE to 0.03457 and smooth subpixel scrolling to 0.02620. Matrix 30 bundled several conservative state changes with its camera fix, so the next probe isolates the minimum unmasked-camera veto on mode 20 textureless fallback/raw-disocclusion behavior instead of replacing the camera evidence globally.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
